invariants.description: Drift detection must evaluate all registered constitutional domains
invariants.enforcement: run_detection iterates _CONSTITUTIONAL_DOMAINS; missing domain raises AssertionError

invariants.description: Every drift event must carry a floating-point entropy score in [0.0, 1.0]
invariants.enforcement: _score_entropy() clamps all raw scores; test T222-ENTR-01 validates bounds

invariants.description: Drift ledger entries must be HMAC-SHA-256 chained; no orphan entries
invariants.enforcement: LedgerEntry.seal() computes over (seq, entry_id, type, payload, ts, prev_hmac)

invariants.description: Chain integrity must be verifiable from genesis to HEAD at any time
invariants.enforcement: verify_chain() traverses full ledger; any break returns valid=False

invariants.description: CRITICAL severity drifts must be quarantined until HUMAN-0 acknowledges
invariants.enforcement: _quarantine dict; human0_acknowledge() is sole removal path

invariants.description: Every drift report must include structured remediation recommendations
invariants.enforcement: All analyzer methods populate ev.remediation with ≥1 concrete action items

invariants.description: Drift event history is immutable; entries may not be deleted or altered
invariants.enforcement: DriftEvent.immutable=True; ledger is append-only JSONL; no delete endpoint

invariants.description: Drift state transitions must complete atomically via os.replace()
invariants.enforcement: _persist_state() writes to .tmp then os.replace() to final path

invariants.description: Every detection run must produce an immutable audit record
Drift reports must be deterministically replayable from ledger state
invariants.enforcement: All report data is derived from ledger; verify_chain() confirms replayability
